inlineFindings.title: Promote observation-write failures above natural expiry
inlineFindings.body: When the natural-window check raises NaturalGraceExpired and persisting the Bee observation also fails (for example, due to the evidence-capacity check or an I/O error), attaching the write failure with add_note() leaves the exception type unchanged. monitor() consequently treats it as a normal natural-boundary transition and discards the note, so closure can succeed and the stage can proceed without the mandatory failure observation or any monitor_errors entry. Preserve the grace exception as context, but raise a distinct INCOMPLETE error for the evidence-write failure so this path cannot be accepted as normal.

inlineFindings.title: Reject oversized partial output from timed-out probes
inlineFindings.body: When lsof times out after producing more than rawBytesPerStream, bee_capture_output() returns False, but this exception path ignores that result and rethrows only TimeoutExpired. The observation therefore retains a truncated prefix while the required capacity overrun is never classified as INCOMPLETE, unlike the completed-process path; this can discard the raw bytes needed to diagnose the Bee failure. Check the return value here and preserve both the timeout and the capacity failure.
